cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Analytical exponential height fog in UE5 ExponentialHeightFog, CryEngine, Frostbite, and Unity HDRP
Explaining why multiplying camera-altitude fog density σ(h_cam) by ray length L buries 240m mountain peaks in 95% valley whiteout
Guarding horizontal rays (k·Δh → 0) with the Taylor series 1 − x/2 + x²/6 to prevent 0/0 NaN artifacts at the camera horizon
Replacing 64-step numerical fog ray marching with a single closed-form antiderivative evaluation
not_for: Spatially heterogeneous 3D noise clouds or local smoke grenades (which require froxel volume ray marching, see Round 52)
Underground caves with strictly uniform constant-density dust (k = 0 everywhere)
Neural single-image dehazing or atmospheric restoration networks
Vacuum space scenes with zero participating media
